preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two integers n and k separated by whitespace.
n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, and k is an integer between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if int(stdin.split()[1]) > int(stdin.split()[0]) * (int(stdin.split()[0]) + 1) // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If k exceeds the maximum possible ones (n*(n+1)//2), output is -1; otherwise, output is a valid matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdout.splitlines()) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, each line in stdout has exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, every element in the matrix is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j]) == int(stdout.splitlines()[j].split()[i]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0])) for j in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, the matrix is symmetric with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0])) for j in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))) == int(stdin.split()[1]) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, the total number of ones in the matrix equals k.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j]) >= int(stdout2.splitlines()[i].split()[j]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0])) for j in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, the matrix is lexicographically maximal among all valid matrices with k ones. (stdout2 is any other valid matrix with the same n and k.)
